Stellam Type 3 is a pair of Legendary Leg Armor that can be obtained as a reward for competing in the Sparrow Racing League limited time event.
Stellam Type 2 is a Legendary Chest Armor that can be obtained as a reward for competing in the Sparrow Racing League limited time event.
Spektar Kallipolis Greaves is a legendary Titan leg armor. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Kallipolis Greaves can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Kallipolis Legs is a legendary Warlock leg armor. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Kallipolis Legs can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Infinite Mask is a legendary Hunter helmet. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Infinite Mask can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Kallipolis Crown is a legendary Titan helmet. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Kallipolis Crown can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Kallipolis Hood is a legendary Warlock helmet. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Kallipolis Hood can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Infinite Plate is a legendary Titan chest armor. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Infinite Plate can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Infinite Robes is a legendary Warlock chest armor. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Infinite Robes can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Kallipolis Robes is a legendary Warlock chest armor. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Kallipolis Robes can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Spektar Kallipolis Vest is a legendary Hunter chest armor. It can also be transferred between characters using the Vault. Spektar Kallipolis Vest can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Terra Bide is an uncommon Warlock chest armor. Terra Bide can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Tengoku FR2 is a basic fusion rifle. It can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.

Thorn is an exotic hand cannon. It used to be acquired by completing the exotic weapon bounty A Light in the Dark. It is currently only obtainable from legacy engrams. Thorn is one of the Weapons of Sorrow that have been constructed using the Hive's forbidden power. It was augmented by Dredgen Yor after he delved into the dark mysticism of the Hive.

The Last Word is an exotic hand cannon. In Year 1, it could be purchased from Xûr or obtained as a random completion reward. It can currently still be obtained as a random drop from Year 1 activities and legacy engrams.
The Chance is a legendary Future War Cult hand cannon. It can be obtained from engrams or purchased from Lakshmi-2.

The Calling is a legendary scout rifle. It can be obtained from Lakshmi-2 for 150 Crucible marks and 1 Crucible Commendation after reaching rank 3 in Future War Cult reputation and from decoding rare and legendary Primary weapon engrams.
Timur's Lash is a legendary hand cannon. It can be obtained as a random completion reward from the Iron Banner Crucible event.
The Devil You Know is a legendary Vanguard hand cannon that can be obtained by doing Vanguard Viper, Eagle and Tiger strikes. It can also be obtained from a vanilla destiny Legendary or Rare Engram.
:This article is about the story mission. For the relic, see Sword of Crota. The Sword of Crota is a story mission in Destiny and takes place in Ocean of Storms, Moon.
The Stranger's Rifle is a legendary pulse rifle. It is gifted from the Exo Stranger after completing The Black Garden for the first time.
The Divide is a location in Old Russia that is controlled by the Fallen. It is also where a Walker public event occurs.

Toland's Legacy was an exotic weapon bounty that ultimately rewarded the exotic pulse rifle Bad Juju. The bounty could be obtained from the Vanguard Mentor Missive, but was made unavailable in The Taken King.
The Chosen is a legendary Future War Cult sniper rifle. It can be obtained from Lakshmi-2 for 150 Crucible marks or from engrams.
The Conduit is a legendary Future War Cult pulse rifle. It can be acquired from engrams or Future War Cult packages.

The Glasshouse is an exotic Titan helmet added in The Dark Below. It can be obtained through random loot drops, purchased from Xûr, or obtained from engrams. This helmet is designed to be used with the Defender subclass.

The Devil You Don't is a legendary hand cannon that can be obtained from the Vanguard ROC strike playlist. It could also be obtained from a Legendary or Rare Engram. It is the linguistic successor to the hand cannon The Devil You Know (Year 1), referencing the adage, “The devil you know is better than the devil you don’t.”
Time On Target is a legendary pulse rifle added in The Dark Below.
Three Little Words is a legendary pulse rifle added in The Dark Below.
The Saterienne Rapier is a legendary scout rifle added in The Dark Below. It can be obtained from engrams or purchased from Arcite 99-40.
Tireless Striders is a pair of Legendary Hunter Leg Armor. They can only be obtained in the Crota's End raid.
The Scholar is a legendary scout rifle that can be earned through the Trials of Osiris.
The Trolley Problem is a legendary fusion rifle added in The Dark Below.
Toutatis Type 2 is rare Titan leg armor. Toutatis Type 2 can be dismantled to generate Glimmer and Armor Materials. It can also be transferred to other characters through the vault.
The Infinite Theorem is a legendary machine gun. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts, and Legendary Marks.
The Messenger is a legendary pulse rifle. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts, and Legendary Marks.

The Elder Cipher was a quest that rewarded a Guardian with Lord of Wolves, Queenbreakers' Bow, or Dreg's Promise. It was received as a random reward immediately after killing the final boss of a level 34 or 35 Prison of Elders challenge activity. In The Taken King, the Elder Cipher is no longer obtainable. The Year 1 weapons are instead obtained randomly from the Queen's Chest at the end of the Level 28 Prison of Elders activity, and the Year 2 weapons are obtained randomly upon returning to orbit at the end of a Challenge of the Elders activity.
The Revelator is a legendary hand cannon introduced in the House of Wolves expansion. It can be obtained as a random loot drop at the end of a Crucible match.
The Summoner is a legendary auto rifle. It is sometimes sold by Brother Vance and requires 7 wins on a Trials Passage to purchase.
The Jade Rabbit is an exotic scout rifle. It was exclusive to PlayStation platforms until October 2017.

The Drifter is a Crucible map introduced in the Destiny expansion The Taken King. This map is set in The Reef where a Fallen Ship was attacked by the Hive and left to rest in space. It is one of the smallest maps in The Taken King and is a symmetrical map with unusual gravity effects due to damage caused by the Hive. As a result, dead Guardians' bodies will not be affected by gravity and ragdoll effects will be more interesting throughout the map.

The Chaperone is an exotic shotgun that can only be obtained by completing the quest Jolly Holliday. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts and an Exotic Shard. This shotgun is very unique in that it fires single slug rounds instead of the normal buckshot.
Valus Tlu'urn is a commander in the Skyburners Legion and an ultra in the Shield Brothers strike.
The First Curse is an exotic hand cannon that can only be obtained by completing the quest Imprecation. It can be dismantled to generate upgrade materials.
Tlaloc is an exotic scout rifle that can only be obtained by completing the quest Back in the Saddle. This weapon is exclusive to Warlocks and cannot be equipped by other classes.
The Dealbreaker is a legendary auto rifle. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts, and Legendary Marks.
The Fear is a legendary rocket launcher. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts, and Legendary Marks.
The Frenzy is a legendary fusion rifle. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts, and Legendary Marks.
The Fulcrum is a legendary hand cannon. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts, and Legendary Marks.
